## Activity

During July 2022, East City Eye Clinic recorded 147 captures. This reflects the imaging activity completed at the site during the month. The activity was reviewed as part of routine site operations monitoring, with attention to the number of captures submitted for assessment and the subsequent image-quality and grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the images captured, 3 were ungradable. The ungradable rate was 2.0 per cent. These results should continue to be monitored through the usual quality-assurance process so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed. The clinic lead has asked that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk.

## Grading

Grading identified 36 referable results. The median grading wait was 26 days. The grading results and turnaround information provide a summary of the month’s referral workload and the time taken for images to proceed through assessment. Site staff should continue to record operational issues consistently and raise equipment concerns through the service desk to support follow-up and ongoing service oversight.
